description: This is an Android activity class named HomeActivity.java, responsible for managing the main weather display screen. It handles user interactions such as searching for a city, refreshing data, voice input, and checking for app updates. It fetches weather data from network APIs, updates the UI accordingly, and manages permissions and connectivity checks.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the weather app, managing UI updates, user interactions, network requests, permissions, and app update checks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI bindings, checks for updates, sets listeners, and fetches initial weather data.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from voice recognition input, updating the city input field and triggering a search.

methods.name: setNavigationBarColor
methods.description: Sets the navigation bar color if the Android version supports it.

methods.name: setUpDaysRecyclerView
methods.description: Initializes the RecyclerView for displaying weather forecast days.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Sets up UI event listeners for user interactions such as search, refresh, and voice input.

methods.name: setRefreshLayoutColor
methods.description: Configures the color scheme for the refresh layout.

methods.name: searchCity
methods.description: Validates and initiates search for a specified city.

methods.name: getDataUsingNetwork
methods.description: Fetches the device's current location and retrieves weather data accordingly.

methods.name: setLatitudeLongitudeUsingCity
methods.description: Fetches geographic coordinates for a city and updates weather data.

methods.name: getTodayWeatherInfo
methods.description: Fetches current weather information from the API and updates the UI.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI components with the latest weather data.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates the day name to a localized version.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator and shows the main layout.

methods.name: hideMainLayout
methods.description: Shows the loading indicator and hides the main layout.

methods.name: hideKeyboard
methods.description: Hides the soft keyboard for a given view.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks internet connectivity and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of location permission requests.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks internet connection when activity resumes.

methods.name: checkUpdate
methods.description: Checks for app updates and initiates immediate update flow if available.
